name: manual_56f671
claim: Treat a board snapshot as a volatile observation, not a source of truth: resolve each task terminal state from its own ordered event timeline before acting. A queue listing read at one moment can show work as open that is already closed, because the board is append-only and busy, so re-read and reconcile per task id rather than reasoning from a single listing.

decisions.notes: An initial queue read showed four open jobs including three Hermes tasks and a CRG wiring task, all of which already had terminal events, one completed and merged and one failed after exhausting retries. The live queue had in fact moved on to a different batch of seven rows. Acting on the stale listing would have meant claiming and executing work that was already finished or abandoned.
